target_units: original cargo units per total berth-hour; actual within-hour moves unavailable
validation_scope: 2025 where all berth-time weather present; non-random event snapshots in 2025
weather_basis: berth-time wind/wave/visibility, NOT entire berth exposure or real-time weather feed
model_source: User supplied v7 Busan7 analysis package, 2020-2025 de-duplicated calls
limitation: Rate is berth-average proxy. Terminal total scenario = predicted vessel-average rate x estimated concurrent berthed vessels (not actual hourly cargo throughput).
